environment.control_notes: No pinning, power/frequency or background-load control.

workload: Repeat the first batch rows of official normalized inputs; no request queue.

result.allocation_probe_scope: Counts replaceable global C++ operator new/new[] and aligned forms via a thread-local counter; excludes malloc/mmap and allocations that bypass these operators.
result.peak_rss_scope: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) ru_maxrss high-water mark for the process, sampled after the benchmark; Linux KiB converted to bytes.
result.timing_scope: Total steady-clock interval around formal iterations, including result checks/consumption/destruction and latency recording; setup, warmup, allocation probe, and reporting are excluded.
result.latency_scope: Per-iteration steady-clock interval around executor.run, result checks/consumption, and result destruction.
result.latency_percentile_method: nearest-rank: sorted sample at ceil(p*N), one-indexed
result.rss_scope: Resident pages from /proc/self/statm multiplied by sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE); sampled after warmup and after formal timing.
